name: Nitten Co., Ltd.
summary: Nitten Co., Ltd., together with its subsidiaries, engages in the manufacture, sale, logistics, and distribution of food products in Japan. It operates through Sugar, Food, Feed, Agricultural Materials, Real Estate, and Other segments. The company offers beet, refined, and pocket sugar; beet and refined molasses; baker's yeast, oligosaccharides, betaine, and other functional food; compound and functional feed for dairy and beef cattle; beet pulp; seeds; and technical assistance solutions, including feed component analysis and design, and farming support services.
